boards.title: Only Happens Here: 10 Traditions That Make No Sense Anywhere Else
boards.description: Ten UAH-documented symbols, rituals, and recurring campus practices that mark Charger identity.

cards.title: Shout the U-A-H battle cry
cards.subtitle: UAH Charger Lore
cards.notes: Listen for the school fight song at Charger gatherings, then join the U-A-H battle cry and blue-and-white refrain when it is performed.
cards.short_summary: UAH’s official fight song gives Charger spirit a distinct call-and-response moment.
cards.evidence_claim: UAH publishes its fight song, including the U-A-H battle cry and blue-and-white refrain, as a Charger tradition.
cards.source_title: Traditions | The University of Alabama in Huntsville
cards.access_notes: A school song rather than a separately ticketed attraction; attend an announced campus or athletics event where it is performed.

cards.title: Raise your voice for the Alma Mater
cards.subtitle: UAH Charger Lore
cards.notes: Learn the Alma Mater’s UAH-specific words before a ceremonial campus gathering so you can recognize the shared song when it is used.
cards.short_summary: The Alma Mater is UAH’s formal song of loyalty and praise.
cards.evidence_claim: UAH lists an Alma Mater with lyrics praising UAH and its community as part of its traditions.
cards.source_title: Traditions | The University of Alabama in Huntsville
cards.access_notes: A ceremonial school-song tradition; availability depends on the program for an announced campus event.

cards.title: Wear the electric blue and white
cards.subtitle: UAH Charger Lore
cards.notes: Use electric blue and white for a campus event or game day to connect with the colors UAH identifies as part of Charger identity.
cards.short_summary: The Charger name and electric blue-and-white palette tie UAH spirit to the region’s electricity history.
cards.evidence_claim: UAH says its athletics squads are called the Chargers in reference to the region’s electricity production and identifies electric blue and white as school hues.
cards.source_title: Traditions | The University of Alabama in Huntsville
cards.access_notes: School-identity practice; wear campus colors at public university events as appropriate.

cards.title: Spot Charger Blue at a campus event
cards.subtitle: UAH Charger Lore
cards.notes: Keep an eye out for Charger Blue at an announced athletic competition, tailgate, or student event and capture a respectful event photo.
cards.short_summary: Charger Blue is the campus mascot associated with UAH spirit events.
cards.evidence_claim: UAH identifies Charger Blue as a campus staple at tailgates, athletic competitions, and student events.
cards.source_title: Traditions | The University of Alabama in Huntsville
cards.access_notes: Mascot appearances depend on the event schedule; follow event staff guidance for photos and interaction.

cards.title: Meet the Lancers
cards.subtitle: UAH Charger Lore
cards.notes: Look for a Lancer during an official university program and ask a practical campus question; they serve as UAH’s student ambassadors.
cards.short_summary: Lancers carry forward UAH’s ambassador tradition through campus representation.
cards.evidence_claim: UAH describes Lancers as official university ambassadors selected for academic excellence, communication skills, and passion for UAH.
cards.source_title: Traditions | The University of Alabama in Huntsville
cards.access_notes: Lancers are encountered through official university programs and outreach; participation or availability varies by event.

cards.title: Make the UAH spirit hand sign
cards.subtitle: UAH Icons
cards.notes: Practice the two-hand U-A-H gesture before a Charger event, then use it in a group photo without blocking anyone’s view.
cards.short_summary: A two-hand sign turns the letters U, A, and H into a compact expression of Charger pride.
cards.evidence_claim: UAH says students use both hands to form U, A, and H as a way to embrace Charger pride.
cards.source_title: Traditions | The University of Alabama in Huntsville
cards.access_notes: An informal, no-equipment school-spirit gesture suitable for public campus events and photos.

cards.title: Recognize a UAH challenge coin
cards.subtitle: UAH Icons
cards.notes: If you receive or see a UAH challenge coin, note the achievement it recognizes and treat it as an honor token rather than a purchase item.
cards.short_summary: UAH adapts the challenge-coin honor tradition for a Huntsville community shaped by military and space work.
cards.evidence_claim: UAH says it gives its own challenge coins and connects the practice to Huntsville’s space and military industries.
cards.source_title: Traditions | The University of Alabama in Huntsville
cards.access_notes: Coins are recognition tokens, not a standing public attraction; receipt depends on university achievement or recognition programs.

cards.title: See the UAH Letters change for campus festivities
cards.subtitle: Outside the Conference Training Center
cards.notes: Visit the UAH Letters outside the Conference Training Center to see their current look; check event guidance before taking part in any painting.
cards.short_summary: The large UAH Letters provide a changing visual marker for Homecoming and Greek Life festivities.
cards.evidence_claim: UAH states that the UAH Letters outside the Conference Training Center are commonly painted for festivities including Homecoming and Greek Life events.
cards.source_title: Traditions | The University of Alabama in Huntsville
cards.access_notes: View the outdoor letters from public campus areas; do not paint or alter them unless an authorized event expressly permits it.

cards.title: Watch for the ceremonial mace at Commencement
cards.subtitle: UAH Commencement tradition
cards.notes: At an official commencement ceremony, watch for the ceremonial mace in the academic procession and observe the ceremony’s seating and photo rules.
cards.short_summary: The ceremonial mace symbolizes UAH leadership and its determination to move forward.
cards.evidence_claim: UAH calls use of the ceremonial mace at Commencement a longstanding tradition representing university leadership and determination to keep moving forward.
cards.source_title: Traditions | The University of Alabama in Huntsville
cards.access_notes: Visible only during official commencement programming; guest admission and venue rules are set for each ceremony.

cards.title: Join the annual ChargerCON gathering
cards.subtitle: UAH Signature Event
cards.notes: Check the current ChargerCON program for tournament, art-festival, and cosplay-contest details, then choose an activity that fits your interests.
cards.short_summary: ChargerCON is UAH’s recurring campus convention for gaming, pop culture, and trading-card communities.
cards.evidence_claim: UAH describes ChargerCON as its annual gaming convention, featuring video game tournaments, an art festival, and a cosplay contest.
cards.source_title: Signature Events | The University of Alabama in Huntsville
cards.access_notes: Annual event; consult the current university program for date, venue, registration, and any activity-specific requirements.
